user.title: Connect to Open Air
user.description: Enter the HTTPS address of your Open Air server and its API token. Fill in the reverse proxy credentials if the server is behind an HTTP Basic access list.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Open Air
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Open Air API token and any HTTP Basic credentials required by the reverse proxy.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Open Air server over HTTPS.
error.invalid_auth: Check the Open Air API token and any reverse proxy credentials.
error.invalid_proxy_auth: Enter both reverse proxy credentials or leave both blank. The username cannot contain a colon.
error.invalid_token: Enter the API token using printable characters without spaces or commas.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin, for example https://radio.example.net, with no path or credentials.
error.unsupported_api: The server does not expose the supported Open Air Home Assistant API. Check the URL and the installed server version.

abort.already_configured: This Open Air server is already configured.
